all_debt_is_bad: Debt is a tool. Borrowing for something that earns or lasts is different from borrowing for something that is gone by Friday.
best_fund_exists: No fund is best every year, and last year's winner is not next year's. Picking by last year's table is how most people buy high.
bonds_are_risk_free: A bond is a loan. If the borrower cannot pay, the bond does not. And its price falls when newer bonds pay more.
buy_now_pay_later_is_free: Pay later is a loan. It is free only if nothing goes wrong and you never miss a date.
cash_at_home_safe: Cash at home is not safer than a bank. It cannot be traced, replaced, or proved to be yours.
chasing_hype: By the time something is everywhere, the rise has usually happened. Buying the story late is how the excitement gets paid for.
click_kyc_link: A real bank does not ask you to finish KYC through a link in a message.
commodity_trading_is_easy_money: Commodity prices follow world demand and currencies, and the contracts are not simple. Easy money is not what this is.
compare_emi_not_total: A small instalment can hide a large total.
debt_is_free_money: Borrowed money is not extra money. It is money you already owe.
dip_means_loss: A price falling is not money lost. It becomes a loss when you sell at the bottom, which is exactly when it feels most sensible.
diversified_means_no_loss: Spreading out reduces the damage any one holding can do. It does not stop a year when nearly everything falls together.
emi_is_the_only_cost: The instalment is not the cost. Processing fees, insurance and late charges sit on top of it.
etf_means_no_risk: An ETF is still the basket it holds. Easy to trade is not the same as safe, and trading it often costs money each time.
everything_i_want_is_need: Not everything you want is a need.
fall_then_rise_same_pct_is_even: Down 50% then up 50% does not get you back. ₹100 falls to ₹50, rises to ₹75. A fall needs a bigger rise to undo it.
fun_is_bad: Spending on fun is not wrong. It just belongs in a jar with a limit.
gold_always_goes_up: Gold has had long flat stretches and falls. It earns nothing while it waits, so the whole return depends on the next price.
gold_has_no_costs: Making charges, the dealer's margin and the gap between buying and selling prices all come first. The metal can rise and you can still be behind.
guaranteed_returns_exist: Nothing that grows faster than a bank deposit is guaranteed. Anyone promising both high returns and no risk is selling you the promise, not the return.
guaranteed_returns_real: Nobody can guarantee a return. Anyone who says so is telling you what you want to hear.
high_rate_is_free_bonus: A high promised rate is the price of a high chance of not being paid. Nobody pays 30% when someone would lend to them at 9%.
high_return_no_risk: Returns and risk travel together. A high return with no risk is someone else's story.
higher_fee_means_better: A fee is charged whether the fund does well or badly. Paying more buys you nothing but a higher bar to clear.
highest_return_is_best: The highest return is useless if you cannot get the money out when you need it, or if the risk is more than you can hold through.
inflation_doesnt_matter: Money left still loses value. The same ₹100 buys less each year.
insurance_is_waste: Insurance feels wasted right up until the month it is the only thing standing between you and a disaster.
interest_always_simple: Most of what you borrow and most of what you save compounds. Assuming it is simple makes a loan look cheaper and savings look smaller than they are.
it_always_comes_back: Markets have recovered before. Individual companies have not — some never trade again. "Always" is doing a lot of work in that sentence.
late_start_is_fine: Years are the part you cannot buy back later. Ten years of compounding is usually worth more than doubling the amount.
loss_only_if_sold: Holding does not undo a fall. If the business itself is worth less, the loss is real whether or not you have sold.
minimum_payment_ok: Paying only the minimum keeps the debt alive and charges you for the privilege.
money_in_box_is_safe: Money that does not grow still shrinks, because prices rise. Safe from theft is not safe from inflation.
one_stock_is_enough: One company can fail completely. Spreading money is what stops one failure becoming all of it.
panic_sell: Selling because a price fell turns a drop on paper into a loss you actually paid for.
panic_selling: Selling in a fall turns a swing into a loss. The plan for a bad month is best decided in a calm one.
past_returns_repeat: What something did last year is not a forecast. Every honest projection says so, in small print you should read.
pay_to_get_job: A real job pays you. Any job that asks you to pay first is not a job.
pin_to_receive: You never need a PIN to receive money. A PIN only ever sends it.
property_always_profits: Property can fall, sit empty, and cost money all year. Registration, repairs and taxes come out of the gain before you see it.
recruiting_is_normal_income: If you are paid for bringing in people rather than for anything sold, the money is coming from the new people. That ends when they stop arriving.
risk_means_only_loss: Risk is how much the result can vary, up as well as down. Taking none has its own cost: being quietly overtaken by prices.
sale_means_saving: A discount on something you were not going to buy is not a saving. It is still spending.
save_what_is_left: Saving what is left over rarely leaves anything.
share_otp: An OTP is a key to your money. Nobody legitimate will ever ask you for it.
sip_guarantees_profit: Investing monthly smooths the price you pay. It does not promise a profit, and it cannot rescue a bad investment.
small_spends_dont_matter: Small spends add up faster than they feel.
speculation_is_investing: If nothing underneath earns anything, you are betting on the next price, not investing. Both can pay; only one has something working for you.
stock_price_equals_company_size: Price per share says nothing about size. A ₹50 share can be a far bigger company than a ₹2,000 one; it depends how many shares there are.
tips_are_reliable: A tip is someone else's guess, and you carry the loss if it is wrong.
too_late_to_report: It is never too late to report a fraud.
